summary: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a US$2 billion offering of 4.500% notes due 2029. The notes are priced at 99.994% of par, with underwriting discounts of 0.100% and net proceeds of approximately US$1.998 billion. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. There are no equity aspects, no change of control, and no strategic event. The notes will be listed on the London Stock Exchange. The filing is a standard shelf takedown, so it does not fit any special-situation category.
